theater: 安塔那那利佛與貝齊博卡河谷

battle.name: 第二次馬達加斯加戰爭
battle.theater: 安塔那那利佛與貝齊博卡河谷
battle.brief: 一八九四年十二月法軍分艦隊攻佔東岸要港圖阿馬西納，第二次法馬戰爭正式開打；一八九五年遠征軍自西岸馬哈贊加沿貝齊博卡河深入高原，法軍的雷管後膛步槍射程遠勝梅里納的舊式火槍隊，首都安塔那那利佛於九月底陷落，王室當場簽下保護國條約。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法蘭西第三共和國與伊默里納（梅里納）王國。法國方面的組織分海陸兩層，並附帶一整套殖民地的輔助部隊。海軍方面由海軍上校（capitaine de vaisseau）阿梅迪·比耶內率領分艦隊，艦上有普里莫熱、于貢、迪佩蒂·圖瓦爾三艘巡洋艦，帕潘、迪蒙多爾維爾兩艘報導艦，林克斯、埃托瓦爾、薩吉泰爾、梅泰奧爾、利夫爾、加貝斯六艘炮艦，以及可作浮橋與登陸碼頭用的連接運輸船科雷茲；這支分艦隊同時負責全島封鎖。陸軍方面是一支專為此次遠征編成的軍團，由師團長雅克·迪舍納指揮，參謀長是旅團長德·托爾西，砲兵指揮安托萬·帕勒上校，後勤指揮莫里斯·巴約上校，情報處長為中校萊昂·德·貝利耶。軍團分成兩個旅：第一旅由旅團長萊昂·梅斯廷格率領，含第四十步兵獵兵營、第二百步兵團，以及阿爾及利亞團（外籍兵團行軍營一個、阿爾及利亞步槍兵營兩個），配第三十八砲團的兩個山砲連與兩個騎砲連；第二旅由旅團長雷吉斯·沃伊龍率領，含海軍陸戰步兵第十三團、一個殖民行軍團（下轄馬達加斯加、豪薩、留尼汪三個營）與兩個山砲連。此外還有第一獵兵團的第十騎兵中隊，以及負責糧秣的第三十連隊運輸隊。馬達加斯加方面是伊默里納王國：女王臘納瓦洛娜三世只是名義上的最高統帥，實權落在兼任攝政的首相賴尼萊亞里沃尼手中；軍隊由西北軍總司令拉馬松巴扎哈統率，下轄拉扎納科姆巴納、拉桑吉、拉巴諾納、拉科通德拉瓦維、拉蘭博齊羅福、拉馬南加拉利與拉尼安扎哈利等各軍區司令。王國以徵兵制維持一支常備軍，理論編制可達二萬至三萬人，另有大批預備兵。英國在這場衝突裡是背景性的角色：一八九〇年八月五日的英法協議中英國承認法國對馬達加斯加的保護國，作為交換則由法國承認英國在桑給巴爾的保護國，德國隨後加入；這條協議等於替法國清除了最大的外交障礙。
countriesEn: The two sides were the French Third Republic and the Merina, or Hova, Kingdom of Madagascar. On the French side the organisation ran in two layers, land and sea, together with a full set of colonial auxiliaries. At sea a squadron under the capitaine de vaisseau Amédée Bienaimé carried the cruisers Primauguet, Hugon and Dupetit Thouart, the avisos Papin and Dumont d'Urville, the gunboats Lynx, Étoile, Sagittaire, Météore, Lièvre and Gabès, and the pontoon transport Corrèze, which could be run ashore as a bridge and landing stage; the same squadron enforced the blockade of the whole island. On land a corps assembled specially for the expedition was commanded by division general Jacques Duchesne, with brigade general de Torcy as chief of staff, colonel Anatole Palle commanding the artillery, colonel Maurice Bailloud in charge of logistics, and lieutenant-colonel Léon de Beylié heading the intelligence service. The corps was split into two brigades. The first, under brigade general Léon Metzinger, held the 40th battalion of chasseurs à pied, the 200th infantry regiment and an Algérie regiment of the Armée d'Afrique, made up of one marching battalion of the Foreign Legion and two battalions of tirailleurs algériens, together with two mountain batteries and two mounted batteries of the 38th artillery regiment. The second brigade, under brigade général Régis Voyron, was formed from the 13th marine infantry regiment, a colonial marching regiment containing Malagasy, Haoussa and Réunion battalions, and two mountain batteries. Outside the brigades came the 10th squadron of the 1st chasseurs d'Afrique and the 30th escort of the train, which carried food and ammunition. On the Malagasy side stood the Merina Kingdom. Queen Ranavalona III was the nominal commander-in-chief, while real power rested with Rainilaiarivony, prime minister and co-regent; the armies were commanded by Ramasombazaha, chief of the north-west army, with regional commanders Razanakombana, Rasanjy, Rabanona, Rakotondravoavy, Ralambotsirofo, Ramangalahy and Rainianjahaly. The kingdom kept a conscript army whose theoretical establishment ran to twenty or thirty thousand men, with a large reserve behind it. Britain played a background role in the conflict: in the Anglo-French convention of 5 August 1890 Britain recognised a French protectorate over Madagascar in return for a French recognition of a British protectorate over Zanzibar, and Germany joined the arrangement later that year, which removed the largest diplomatic obstacle in front of France.
people: 主導這場遠征的是師團長雅克·迪舍納。他是聖西爾軍校出身，普法戰爭時在索爾費里諾受過傷，之後在北圜與法中戰爭打過仗，具備殖民地作戰經驗；他主張放棄東岸，改在西岸馬哈贊加登陸，再沿貝齊博卡河谷與高原山道直取首都。為他勘察路線與偵察地形的是中校萊昂·德·貝利耶，最早主張以馬哈贊加為主要登陸點的也是他。第一旅旅團長梅斯廷格率阿爾及利亞團與第二百步兵團作戰，一八九五年四月初攻取米亞達納，六月底再攻下貝里察山上的梅里納軍營。第二旅旅團長沃伊龍於八月二十二日攻占安德里巴。砲兵主任安托萬·帕勒上校把三個砲兵連配給決定性的輕縱隊，後勤主任莫里斯·巴約上校負責把四千輛輕便馬車與馬騾編排成兩段補給線。首批登陸的東岸部隊由中校科隆納·德·喬韋利納率領，佔領圖阿馬西納的即是該支隊伍。運輸隊長德姆中隊長統計出法籍軍官四十四人、非軍官與車夫八百六十人、原住民車夫四千二百七十人，這說明這支部隊的車馬其實多由當地人拉動。巴黎方面，卡西米爾·佩里耶內閣在一八九四年一月二十二日取得國會全票通過的白紙授權，總督代表勒·米爾·德·維萊爾在談判中先行攤牌，實際上等於宣戰；海軍上校比耶內在十二月七日戰爭撥款通過當日便收到命令。馬達加斯加方面，賴尼萊亞里沃尼自一八六八年起執政，前後掌權近三十年，他以英國的商貿往來制衡法國，又聘請歐洲軍事顧問舍維頓上校赴歐洲採購新式槍炮。女王臘納瓦洛娜三世一八八三年登基，此時已是老於世故的君主，拒絕接受法國提出的保護國文本。軍方以拉馬松巴扎哈為西北戰區總司令，他麾下受過歐洲訓練的精銳炮兵隊在內陸被法軍砲兵消滅。內政大臣拉尼安德里亞曼帕德里與拉齊馬芒加親王在戰後被加里埃尼交軍法會議判處死刑，於一八九六年十月十五日公開槍決。加里埃尼一八九六年九月十五日抵達安塔那那利佛，一八九七年二月二十八日夜拘捕女王，翌晨廢除君主制並自任總督；參與平定的青年軍官中，有日後在一九一四年統率法軍的約瑟夫·約福。
peopleEn: The man who directed the expedition was division general Jacques Duchesne. He came from Saint-Cyr, had been wounded at Solferino in the Franco-Prussian War, and had afterwards served in Tonkin and in the Sino-French War, so he had genuine colonial experience. He argued for leaving the east coast alone and landing on the west coast at Mahajanga, then driving up the Betsiboka valley and the highland tracks straight at the capital. The reconnaissance and the mapping of the route were done by lieutenant-colonel Léon de Beylié, who had first urged Mahajanga as the principal landing place. Brigade general Metzinger, commanding the first brigade, led the Algérie regiment and the 200th infantry in action: they took Miadana in the first days of April 1895 and the end of June saw them storm the Hova camp on Mont Beritza. Brigade general Voyron took Andriba on 22 August. Colonel Anatole Palle, the artillery director, put three batteries into the decisive light column, and colonel Maurice Bailloud, the logistics director, organised four thousand light carts and the horses and mules into two sections of the supply line. The first troops to land on the east coast were led by lieutenant-colonel Colonna de Giovellina, and it was his men who occupied Toamasina. The convoy commander, chef d'escadron Deyme, counted forty-four French officers, eight hundred and sixty French non-commissioned officers and drivers, and four thousand two hundred and seventy indigenous drivers, which shows how much of the draught work was in local hands. In Paris, the Casimir-Perier cabinet obtained a unanimous blank cheque from parliament on 22 January 1894, and the resident-general Le Myre de Vilers confronted the Malagasy side in the negotiations, which was war in all but name; the naval commander Bienaimé had his orders on the very day the war credits were voted, 7 December. On the Malagasy side, Rainilaiarivony had governed since 1868 and would hold power for close to thirty years; he balanced France against Britain through trade and engaged a European military adviser, Colonel Shervinton, to buy arms in Europe. Queen Ranavalona III had come to the throne in 1883 and was by now a practised judge of men, and she refused the French protectorate text. On the Malagasy military side Ramasombazaha commanded the north-west theatre, and his gunners, trained in Europe, were destroyed by French artillery inland. The minister of the interior, Rainandriamampandry, and Prince Ratsimamanga were tried by a military court after the war and shot in public on 15 October 1896. Gallieni arrived at Antananarivo on 15 September 1896, arrested the queen during the night of 28 February 1897, and abolished the monarchy the following morning, becoming governor-general himself; among the young officers who served in the pacification was Joseph Joffre, who would command the French army in 1914.
kits: 這場戰爭的裝備對比，一句話講完：法軍的骨幹是雷管點火的後膛步槍，梅里納軍的骨幹是前裝的舊式火槍。雷管步槍在法軍體系裡的位置最清楚：步兵線列裝備一八六六年沙什波式與一八八六年勒貝爾式後膛步槍，槍機皆以雷管擊發，一八八六年式更帶五發彈匣，射程與射擊節奏都遠勝前裝槍；此外尚存一八七四年格拉絲式步槍與各型卡賓槍，砲兵使用第三十八砲團的山砲與騎砲，海上則是分艦隊的艦炮與登陸後的岸上砲兵。梅里納軍的槍械以歐洲舊貨為主：步槍是前裝的燧發滑膛槍，巴黎軍械庫至今仍藏有數支馬達加斯加製的燧發槍；同時他們也持有後膛炮，這是首相賴尼萊亞里沃尼透過歐洲顧問在英國與歐洲買到的，數量不多，但足以在隘口與山頭壓制法軍前哨。步兵仍以長矛與皮盾為主，軍官穿歐式制服，多數士兵仍是便服，腳力與糧秣全靠國民動員。運輸是這一戰最吃重的環節：法軍訂購五千輛勒費弗爾式輕便馬車，空車重三百三十五公斤、每車載重二百五十公斤、由一頭騾拖曳，實配四千輛，配馬騾四千五百匹，另有原住民車夫四千二百七十人；為讓這些車通行，遠征軍不得不從登陸點一路修築可通車的道路。決定性的輕縱隊配備約四千人（有史料記四千二百五十名戰鬥員）、三個砲兵連、三百名法籍車夫、一千五百名卡比爾人、二百五十匹馬與二千八百頭騾，載二十天口糧。真正把兩邊拉開距離的還有海軍：分艦隊的封鎖切斷了梅里納從海外取得新式雷管步槍與後膛炮的通道，這正是這件兵器在戰局裡的真正位置——它決定了誰能在對方還沒瞄準之前先開火。
kitsEn: The contrast in equipment can be put in a single sentence: the backbone of the French army was the percussion-fired breech-loading rifle, and the backbone of the Merina army was the old muzzle-loading musket. The place of the percussion rifle in the French system is clear. The infantry line carried the Chassepot model 1866 and the Lebel model 1886, both breech-loaders whose actions were fired by percussion, the 1886 pattern taking a five-round magazine, so that both range and rate of fire were far beyond anything a muzzle-loader could do. There were also surviving Gras model 1874 rifles and carbines of several patterns, the artillery of the 38th regiment provided mountain and mounted guns, and at sea the squadron's ship guns were followed by shore batteries once the landings were made. The Malagasy arms were largely European surplus. Their muskets were muzzle-loading flintlocks, and the Musée de l'Armée in Paris still holds a number of Malagasy-made flintlock muskets of this period. At the same time they did possess breech-loading guns, bought in Britain and on the Continent by Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony through his European advisers; few in number, they were enough to dominate the French outposts at the passes and on the hills. The infantry still fought with spears and hide shields, the officers wore European uniforms, most of the men were still in civilian dress, and manpower, food and transport depended entirely on the national levy. Transport was the heaviest part of the campaign. The French ordered five thousand Lefebvre light carts, each with a tare of three hundred and thirty-five kilograms, a load of two hundred and fifty kilograms, and a single mule in front; four thousand were in service, drawn by four thousand five hundred horses and mules, with four thousand two hundred and seventy indigenous drivers. To make those carts pass, the expedition had to build a coachable road all the way from the landing place. The decisive light column carried about four thousand men, in one account four thousand two hundred and fifty combatants, with three artillery batteries, three hundred French drivers, fifteen hundred Kabyles, two hundred and fifty horses and two thousand eight hundred mules, and twenty days of rations. What truly separated the two sides was also the navy: the squadron's blockade cut off the Malagasy ability to buy new percussion rifles and breech-loading guns from abroad. That is the real place of this weapon in the war. It decided who could fire first, before the other side had even brought the rifle to the shoulder.
tactics: 法軍的戰術是封鎖加正面推壓，兩者缺一不可。海軍先以分艦隊封鎖全島海岸，佔領東岸的圖阿馬西納與西岸的馬哈贊加兩個港口，把梅里納的對外通道掐斷；陸軍主力不走東岸，而是在馬哈贊加登陸後沿貝齊博卡河谷北進，靠工兵在沼澤與山嶺之間鑿出可通車的道路，再以梯次配置把部隊沿補給線拉開。行軍速度極慢，主力每天只能推進約七公里，七月前連翻三道五百至一千二百公尺的山嶺，勒費弗爾馬車載量有限，一旦脫離補給線，前線就只剩下一個前哨。一八九五年六月二十九日設在圖薩拉薩奧特拉的孤立前哨（阿爾及利亞步槍兵一個連、砲兵一個排、獵兵一個排）被千餘名梅里納兵攻擊，靠步槍齊射把敵人擋在射程之外，再由獵兵反擊擊退，敵軍退上貝里察山；三十日由第四十獵兵營攻下該營，法軍方面僅八人受傷。八月推進至距首都二百公里的安德里巴後，迪舍納抽出輕縱隊，以二十天口糧走完一百五十公里，用了十六天，九月十五日在齊納伊農德里、十七日在基安加拉隘口、十九日在安博希梅納山區連打三場戰鬥。最後一擊由砲兵執行：法軍把砲口對準安塔那那利佛高地上的王宮，據法方記錄只打了極少數發炮彈（一說三發），第一發炮彈落地，王室當即投降並在十月一日簽署保護國條約，法軍隨即進城。梅里納方面的戰術是守路：以徵召民兵在隘口、山頭與道路轉折處設營，用舊式火槍齊射與伏擊拖住法軍，砲兵在路口施壓；但火槍射程與射速不及後膛雷管步槍，隊形一旦被法軍散兵與砲火逼近就會立刻散開，節制的部署反而讓部隊在幾次接觸裡被逐一吃掉。戰後加里埃尼改用據點逐段推進的油漬式戰法掃平地方起義，直到一九〇五年才算平定。
tacticsEn: French tactics were the sum of a blockade and a frontal push, and neither could do without the other. The squadron first sealed the coast of the island, took the two ports of Toamasina on the east and Mahajanga on the west, and cut the Merina off from the outside world. The main army did not use the east coast at all: it landed at Mahajanga and pushed north up the Betsiboka valley, with the engineers cutting a coachable road through marsh and mountain, and the troops echeloned back along that supply line. The pace was terrible. The main body advanced about seven kilometres a day, crossed three massifs of five hundred to twelve hundred metres before July, and because a Lefebvre cart carried so little, once the column left the supply road the front was reduced to a single outpost. On 29 June 1895 the isolated post at Tsarasaotra, a company of tirailleurs algériens with a section of artillery and a peloton of chasseurs d'Afrique, was attacked by more than a thousand Merina men. Volley fire held them at the range the old muskets could not match, a counter-attack by the chasseurs broke them, and they withdrew up Mont Beritza; on the 30th the 40th battalion of chasseurs à pied took the camp, and the French counted only eight wounded. After the advance reached Andriba, two hundred kilometres from the capital, in August, Duchesne detached the light column, which carried twenty days of rations over one hundred and fifty kilometres in sixteen days, and fought at Tsinainondry on 15 September, at the Kiangara pass on the 17th, and in the Ambohimena mountains on the 19th. The last blow was delivered by the artillery: the French trained their guns on the royal palace from the heights above Antananarivo, and by the French account only a very few shells were fired, three according to one version, the first of which brought the royal house to its knees, and the protectorate act was signed on 1 October as the French entered the city. The Malagasy method was to hold the road. Conscript levies camped at the passes, on the hills and at the bends of the track, holding the French with musket volleys and ambushes and pressing them with their guns from the roadside. But the range and rate of fire of a flintlock musket could not match a percussion breech-loader, and once French skirmishers and artillery closed on them the Merina formations came apart at once, so their cautious deployments were picked off in detail at each contact. After the war Gallieni changed to a method of advancing in strongpoints, an oil-stain spread of posts, to sweep up the local insurrections, and the island was not pacified until 1905.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。法軍遠征軍編制約一萬五千人，另有六千至七千名搬運工（法方史料記一萬四千人與七千名搬運工，中英兩種統計則作一萬五千人與六千名搬運工）；軍團分兩個旅，另有一個騎兵中隊與六連制的運輸隊。梅里納方面有常備軍約三萬人、預備兵約四萬人，中文維基引一八九五年紐約時報的說法則指傷亡或被俘達七萬；其徵兵制常備軍的理論編制另記為二萬至三萬人。各家數字相差很大，可以確定的是梅里納的兵力遠多於法軍，但真正投入前線並受過線列射擊訓練的只是其中一小部分。法軍作戰損失極小，陣亡二十五人（法方另記二十人），因病死亡五千五百五十六人，多數史料作約六千人，遠征軍因此損失四成兵力；梅里納作戰陣亡約四千五百人。距離與時間：安德里巴距首都二百公里，輕縱隊走一百五十公里用十六天，主力每天推進約七公里，自一八九五年四月二十三日登陸到九月底攻入首都約五個月。運輸數字：勒費弗爾馬車訂購五千輛、實配四千輛，馬騾四千五百匹，原住民車夫四千二百七十人，法籍軍官四十四人、非軍官與車夫八百六十人，輕縱隊另配二千八百頭騾、二百五十匹馬與一千五百名卡比爾人。海軍方面為巡洋艦三、報導艦兩、炮艦六、浮橋運輸船一。制度上的數字：一八九六年一月十五日以法律設立遠征勳章，約二萬人獲授，遠多於第一次遠征的約二千五百枚；受勳團隊的旗幟上添上馬達加斯加一八九五與塔那那利佛一八九五字樣。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The French expeditionary corps numbered about fifteen thousand men, with six to seven thousand porters or carriers, the French accounts giving fourteen thousand men and seven thousand carriers while the Chinese and English statistics give fifteen thousand men and six thousand carriers; the corps was divided into two brigades, with one cavalry squadron and a train escort of six companies besides. On the Malagasy side there were some thirty thousand regular soldiers and forty thousand reservists, while the Chinese Wikipedia, citing the New York Times of 1895, gives seventy thousand casualties; the theoretical establishment of the conscript army is also given as twenty to thirty thousand men. The sources disagree widely, but what is certain is that the Merina had far more men than France, while only a small fraction of them were actually in the line and trained to fire in formation. French losses in action were very small, twenty-five dead, or twenty in another account, while five thousand five hundred and fifty-six died of disease, most sources giving about six thousand, so the expedition lost some forty per cent of its strength; Merina dead in action are given as about four thousand five hundred. Distances and timings: Andriba lies two hundred kilometres from the capital, the light column covered one hundred and fifty kilometres in sixteen days, the main body advanced about seven kilometres a day, and about five months separated the landing on 23 April 1895 from the entry into the capital at the end of September. On transport: five thousand Lefebvre carts were ordered and four thousand in service, four thousand five hundred horses and mules, four thousand two hundred and seventy indigenous drivers, forty-four French officers and eight hundred and sixty French non-commissioned officers and drivers, while the light column carried two thousand eight hundred mules, two hundred and fifty horses and fifteen hundred Kabyles. The navy was three cruisers, two avisos, six gunboats and one pontoon transport. On institutions: the Madagascar expedition medal was created by law of 15 January 1896 and awarded to about twenty thousand men, far more than the roughly two thousand five hundred of the first expedition, and the flags of the decorated regiments carried the legends Madagascar 1895 and Tananarive 1895.
cause: 起因是一八八五年《塔馬塔維條約》留下的模糊地帶。那份條約在形式上承認馬達加斯加國的地位，實質上卻讓法國主持當地的對外關係，被後世稱為幽靈保護國；法國要的是一份明白寫出保護國的條文，王室則想保住實質的獨立。雙方僵持近十年：一八九〇年八月五日英法協議中英國承認法國對馬達加斯加的保護國，法國則承認英國在桑給巴爾的保護國，德國同年十一月加入，蘇伊士運河通航後島上英國的傳教與商貿利益被一併納入法國的交換籌碼，這條協議使英國不會在遠征時伸手干涉。一八九二年起法國殖民政黨要求把保護國真正落實，留尼汪出身的議員德·馬伊甚至主張直接吞併；一八九四年一月二十二日卡西米爾·佩里耶內閣取得國會的一致白紙授權，理由寫的是維持我們的處境與權利、恢復秩序、保護本國人、維護國旗。梅里納朝廷這邊則有自己的算盤：賴尼萊亞里沃尼想用英國制衡法國，聘請歐洲軍事顧問在英國購買新式槍炮，同時拒絕讓法國控制外交。僵局的最終引爆點是一八九四年十月二十二日女王正式拒絕法方的保護國文本；法國隨即在十月二十五日撤走本國僑民，十二月七日國會通過戰爭撥款，十二月十二日分艦隊在東岸開火，戰爭就此開始。背景是法國一八七〇年輸掉普法戰爭後急需在海外找回聲望與市場，而馬達加斯加扼守通往印度的航路，在蘇伊士運河通航後雖已不如從前關鍵，仍是法國在印度洋上唯一能建成的據點。
causeEn: The cause lay in the ambiguous zone left behind by the Treaty of Tamatave of 1885. That treaty formally recognised the Malagasy state while in substance entrusting France with the conduct of its external relations, and it has been called a ghost protectorate ever since. France wanted a text that set out a protectorate in plain terms; the court wanted to keep sovereignty in everything but name. The deadlock ran for close to ten years. In the Anglo-French convention of 5 August 1890 Britain recognised a French protectorate over Madagascar in return for a French recognition of a British protectorate over Zanzibar, and Germany joined in November of the same year; with the Suez Canal open, the British missionary and commercial interests on the island were folded into the French side of the bargain, and the convention meant Britain would not reach into the war. From 1892 the French colonial party pressed for the protectorate to be made real, and the Réunion deputy de Mahy went further and demanded outright annexation. On 22 January 1894 the Casimir-Perier cabinet obtained a unanimous blank cheque from parliament, on the stated ground of maintaining our position and our rights, restoring order, protecting our nationals and making our flag respected. The Merina court had calculations of its own: Rainilaiarivony meant to hold France in check through Britain, employed a European military adviser to buy new guns in England, and refused to let France control the island's diplomacy. The flashpoint came on 22 October 1894, when the queen formally rejected the French protectorate text; France evacuated its nationals on the 25th, parliament voted the war credits on 7 December, and on 12 December the squadron opened fire on the east coast and the war had begun. Behind all this lay the fact that France, having lost the Franco-Prussian War in 1870, needed overseas victories for its prestige and its markets, and Madagascar commanded the sea road to India, less vital after the opening of the Suez Canal but still the only base France could build in the Indian Ocean.
impact: 影響分三層。在馬達加斯加本地，保護國成立後賴尼萊亞里沃尼被罷免並流放，一八九五年十二月十一日法國以單方面法令、一八九六年八月六日又以法律把島嶼吞併，劃歸殖民部；一八九七年二月二十八日夜加里埃尼拘捕女王，翌晨廢除延續了一百零三年的君主制，王室成員被逐一流放，王冠與宮殿珍玩成為法國陸軍的戰利品，法軍士兵在王宮內大肆劫掠，現存巴黎軍械庫的臘納瓦洛娜三世王冠其實是裝飾冠，真正的王冠在二〇一一年失竊、二〇二〇年歸還。梅里納的傳統徵兵軍制隨之瓦解，地方起義此起彼伏，一八九六年末以加里埃尼為首的鎮壓展開，直到一九〇五年才算把全島平定；在法國本土，這場戰爭提供了最早的成規模熱帶遠征經驗，也暴露了醫療與後勤的致命缺口，遠征軍四成兵力死於疾病遠多於戰死，直接催生了後來更完整的殖民衛生與軍醫制度。長期看，馬達加斯加從此併入法國的帝國體系，島上居民被大量徵召入法軍：一九一四至一九一八年間先後有四萬一千三百五十五名馬達加斯加人被徵召，其中三萬四千三百八十六人赴歐洲作戰，二千三百六十八人死亡或失聯，另有六千人被徵到法國從事勞動；一九四二年英國遠征軍在島上登陸，與維希法軍交火，法國在當地的聲望重挫；一九四七年大規模起義被武力鎮壓，一九五八年十月十日法國給予自治，一九六〇年六月二十六日簽署獨立，馬達加斯加才算恢復國家地位。這場戰爭留下的軍事物資也成為後世談殖民戰爭的常備案例：遠征勳章、團旗上的地名標記，以及被陳列在巴黎軍械庫的馬達加斯加火槍與後膛炮。
impactEn: The effects work on three levels. In Madagascar itself, once the protectorate was in place Rainilaiarivony was dismissed and exiled, and France annexed the island by unilateral decree on 11 December 1895 and by law on 6 August 1896, attaching it to the ministry of the colonies. In the night of 28 February 1897 Gallieni arrested the queen, abolished the monarchy the following morning, and ended a hundred and three years of monarchy; the royal family was exiled one by one, the crown and the palace treasure became booty for the French army, and the soldiers looted the palace freely. The crown of Ranavalona III now in the Musée de l'Armée is in fact a decorative head-dress; the real crown was stolen in 2011 and returned in 2020. The old Merina conscript system collapsed with the monarchy, local risings broke out in succession, and the repression led by Gallieni from the end of 1896 was not to pacify the whole island until 1905. In France the war furnished the first large-scale tropical expedition experience and at the same time exposed the fatal gaps in its medicine and logistics, since four tenths of the expedition died of disease and far more than of enemy fire, and this drove the creation of a fuller colonial health and medical service. In the long run Madagascar was drawn into the French imperial system, and Malagasy men were mobilised into the French army in large numbers: between 1914 and 1918 some forty-one thousand three hundred and fifty-five Malagasy were called up, of whom thirty-four thousand three hundred and eighty-six went to Europe, two thousand three hundred and sixty-eight were killed or missing, and six thousand more were recruited for labour in France. In 1942 a British expeditionary force landed on the island and fought the Vichy French, and French prestige there suffered badly; the rising of 1947 was put down by force, autonomy came on 10 October 1958, and independence was signed on 26 June 1960, so that Madagascar only recovered the status of a state at that point. The military relics of the war have become a standing case study in the literature of colonial warfare: the expedition medal, the place names on the regimental colours, and the Malagasy muskets and breech-loading guns displayed in the Musée de l'Armée in Paris.
result: 結果是法國的目標達成，王室在最後一刻崩潰。一八九五年九月三十日法軍砲兵把王宮列入射界，第一發炮彈落下，臘納瓦洛娜三世即同意停火並於十月一日簽署保護國條約，法軍當日進入安塔那那利佛；梅里納軍在最後幾次接觸中傷亡約四千五百人，賴尼萊亞里沃尼被解除攝政與首相之職、流放至阿爾及爾，九個月後死於當地。戰役的勝負與代價極不對稱：法軍作戰陣亡僅二十餘人，遠征軍約六千人死於瘧疾、痢疾與傷寒，約四成兵力就這樣耗在從馬哈贊加到安塔那那利佛的一條山路上，軍團原有建制幾乎被疾病打散。反過來說，梅里納王國輸掉的不只是一座都城：常備軍被解散，王室的土地與世襲權被剝奪，國家的行政與稅收逐步移交法國總督府，一八九六年之後的反抗失去統一指揮，只剩各地零星起義，法國以據點逐段推進的辦法又用了近十年才將它們壓下去。因此這場戰爭的直接結果是馬達加斯加在名義上獨立、實質上被併入法蘭西第三共和國的殖民體系，真正恢復獨立的時間是一九六〇年；而把國家交到最後的關鍵人物，是率軍攻入首都的迪舍納與接管全島的加里埃尼。
resultEn: The result was that France got what it came for and the royal house collapsed at the last moment. On 30 September 1895 the French artillery brought the palace under fire, and the first shell that landed was enough for Ranavalona III to agree to stop the fighting; the protectorate act was signed on 1 October and the French entered Antananarivo the same day. The Merina army lost about four thousand five hundred men in the last few contacts, and Rainilaiarivony was stripped of his regency and his premiership and exiled to Algiers, where he died nine months later. The balance of victory and cost was lopsided: only a little over twenty Frenchmen were killed in action, while about six thousand of the expedition died of malaria, dysentery and typhoid, some forty per cent of its strength simply used up on the single road from Mahajanga to Antananarivo, and the organisation of the corps almost dissolved by disease. In the other direction, the Merina Kingdom lost more than its capital: the conscript army was disbanded, the land and hereditary rights of the royal house were stripped away, and the administration and the revenue of the country passed by degrees to the French resident. The resistance that followed in 1896 lost any unified command and broke into scattered risings, which France took the better part of a decade to crush by advancing in strongpoints. The direct result of the war was therefore that Madagascar remained independent in name while being drawn in substance into the colonial system of the French Third Republic, and the true restoration of independence did not come until 1960. The two men who delivered the country at the end were the commander who marched into the capital, Duchesne, and the governor who took over the island, Gallieni.
